# Migrate from 4.x to 5.0

This guide is generated from the deprecation fragments, the breaking-change register (`docs/release/breaking-changes.json`), the codemod catalogue and each component's metadata. Every deprecation entry has an anchor equal to its `doc` link, and every breaking change has a `#b-<n>` anchor.

## Before you start {#before-you-start}

1. Upgrade to the latest 4.3 release first. In development builds, 4.2 and 4.3 print a one-time console warning when your app uses a renamed or removed export, prop or CLI command. The warning names the entry id and its anchor on this page.
2. Run `npx @auraglass/cli doctor --v5` in your app. It lists every call site that 5.0 removes, grouped by the codemod that rewrites it, and marks the ones that need a manual change.
3. Check the runtime floors: React 19 and Node.js 20.19 or later. 5.0 ships ES modules only. See [B1](#b-1) and [B2](#b-2).
4. Commit or stash your work. `migrate 4to5` refuses to write into a dirty Git tree unless you pass `--allow-dirty`.

## Run the codemods {#run-the-codemods}

Preview every change first, then apply it:

```sh
npx @auraglass/cli migrate 4to5 --dry-run
npx @auraglass/cli migrate 4to5 --report migrate-report.json
```

The command exits non-zero while any `TODO(aura-glass 5)` comment remains. Each TODO links to the section below that explains the manual step. Use `--transform <id>[,<id>]` to run one transform at a time. Automation `full` means the transform rewrites every case it matches. `review` means it rewrites what it can and leaves a TODO for the rest.

## By component {#by-component}

Every 5.0 component that replaces 4.x exports, with its prop renames and the CSS selectors to update in your own stylesheets and tests. Rows come from the component's metadata, the same data the codemods use.

{/* @generated by-component */}

## Removed with no successor {#removed-with-no-successor}

These APIs have no direct 5.0 replacement. Where a registry item covers the use case, copy it into your app with the CLI. Otherwise stay on the 4.x LTS line for that part of your app until you can rewrite it.

{/* @generated removed */}

## Rollback {#rollback}

The codemods only edit source files, so rolling back is a version pin plus a revert:

1. Pin the previous major in `package.json` (`"aura-glass": "^4"`) and reinstall.
2. Revert the codemod commit (`git revert <sha>`). If you ran without committing, restore with `git checkout -- .`.
3. If only some screens break, keep 5.0 and import the 4.x names from `aura-glass/compat`. Entries that list a compat adapter above keep working through 5.x and still warn in development.
4. Report the regression with the output of `npx @auraglass/cli doctor --v5 --json` attached.
